title: Cancel a subscription
summary: Written cancellation with a paper trail; chargeback fallback if billed after.
goal_default: Please stop all future billing and confirm the cancellation in writing with a confirmation number and effective date.

rights.claim: Charges applied after a confirmed cancellation are routinely reversed by card issuers.
rights.basis: Card-scheme chargeback rules covering cancelled or unauthorised recurring services.

rights.claim: Cancellation flows that require phone calls or hide the cancel option are dark patterns under regulatory scrutiny.
Keep the confirmation number and a screenshot as proof of the cancellation.
rights.basis: Evidentiary best practice for a later dispute.

ladder: Card-issuer chargeback if charged after a confirmed cancel
State AG / FTC (or national consumer regulator) complaint for dark-pattern cancel walls

artifact.subject: Cancellation of my subscription{{account_suffix}} — written notice
artifact.body:
To: {{target}} Billing/Support

Hello,

I am writing to cancel my subscription{{account_suffix}}, effective immediately. {{goal}}

Please treat this email as formal written notice. I am not requesting a retention offer. If any charge is applied after this notice, I will dispute it with my card issuer as a cancelled service.

Please reply within 5 business days with written confirmation.

Sincerely,
{{name}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
